title: Invalid/unknown post_type filter value falls back to showing all results
steps: Navigate to https://dev.skyline.glass/?s=glass with an unrecognized post_type filter value applied (e.g. via direct URL parameter manipulation)
expected_result: Page does not error; falls back to displaying the unfiltered "all results" set for the query, matching TC-SEARCH-RESULTSPAGE-001 behavior.
